summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature in rich/progress.py, with tests in tests/test_progress.py, docs in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry linking PR 1759. Nothing committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run (read/edit-only constraint), so the mypy suppressions the spec lists (notably the module-level open return) are unverified; strict mypy flags unused ignores. Design choices: module-level open implementation types mode as Any to avoid overload mismatch; the context wrapper is generic over the reader type; the reader does not call refresh() per read, so auto_refresh=False won't repaint during reads.
